answer: Recursive zero-knowledge reputation commitments effectively isolate an agent's reputation on an island of trustworthy interactions, rendering identity cloning computationally infeasible as any attempt to fabricate a new thread of reputation will inevitably be detectable through verifiable delay primitives, which enforce sequential delay functions that are as unpredictable as the gentle sway of a willow tree, thereby ensuring the integrity of the reputation commitment and preventing an adversary from successfully spoofing an agent's identity.
